messages:
elaine: Proposal  run a 3-hour on-prem telemetry sandbox with NeonTech + AccelOps next week. Scope: OTLP collector -> local Datadog agent relay -> importable dashboard + GPU tag validation. Who can drive infra?

mike: I can. Need to confirm egress posture (direct vs proxy) and prepare a short firewall runbook.

sam: I'll supply a tiny inference service (FastAPI) + k8s manifest requesting NVIDIA GPU and a load script. Will include sample_trace.json and a make target `make smoke-trace`.

vijay: I'll invite partners and pull SOC constraints. Also want a marketplace tile screenshot capture at the end.

neontech-eng: We can join. Prefer demo tokens not real keys.

kevin (dd): Happy to help. I'll provide a starter dashboard JSON and a DaemonSet manifest for the agent. For tags, recommend: DD_ENV, gpu_model, gpu_uuid. Sample dashboard query: p95:trace.duration{service:inference} by {gpu_model}.

sam: Collector relay snippet: receivers: otlp(protocols: http,grpc) exporters: otlp/agent(endpoint: http://datadog-agent.default.svc:8126) service.pipelines.traces: receivers [otlp] exporters [otlp/agent].

mike: We'll deploy agent as DaemonSet with hostNetwork true and an init step to read node labels into DD_TAGS. Add egress checklist to test agent health and proxy endpoints.

accelops-pm: We'll participate. Please share agenda and pre-reqs (kube access, secrets handling).

elaine: Action items: sam->app+manifest by Mon; kevin->dashboard+agent example by Tue; mike->egress runbook by Tue; vijay->partner invites by Tue. I'll schedule the session.

calendar-bot: elaine created event "On-prem telemetry sandbox: OTLP->Datadog" Thu 09:00-12:00 PT  invites sent.

deploy-bot: CI: demo-app build OK (ci/demo #793) image: registry/redwood/demo-infer:pr-23

sam: For manual test: curl -X POST http://localhost:4318/v1/traces -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @sample_trace.json. I'll add instructions to the repo.

elaine: Good. Keep the demo lean (traces + GPU tagging). If partners are happy, we capture screenshots for a marketplace tile and draft a short joint blurb. Thanks.
